inline_text:
##Outcome
A standardized telemetry specification and implementation pattern for propagating, correlating, and recording agent identity across distributed traces, metrics, and structured logs, including semantic conventions, baggage propagation rules, and credential redaction controls.

##Workstream:
Observability & Telemetry WG (with cross-review from Security&Privacy, Identity & Trust)

##Owner
needs owner

##Status
scoping

##Next Step

Draft the initial OpenTelemetry semantic convention proposal for agent identity attributes and construct a minimal reproduction trace validating baggage propagation across an asynchronous multi-agent dispatch loop.

##Review or Decision 

- NeededTelemetry/SRE review and approval on proposed span attributes, cardinality limits, and baggage injection rules.
- Security & Compliance confirmation on telemetry boundary policies (specifically: which identity identifiers are permissible in APM backends versus what must be restricted to dedicated audit stores).
- 2-week review window following publication of the trace propagation prototype and schema draft.
 
##Links

- [OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions (General & LLM)](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/)
- [W3C Trace Context Specification](https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/)
- [W3C Baggage Specification](https://www.w3.org/TR/baggage/)
- [OpenTelemetry Context Propagation Guide](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/concepts/context-propagation/)
- [aauth.dev Draft Specification (Reference for token claims)](https://aauth.dev/)
- [OpenID COAZ-MCP-binding](https://openid.github.io/authzen/authzen-coaz-mcp-binding-1_0.html)

Acceptance Criteria[ ] 

- [ ] Defined semantic conventions for agent identity attributes across
- [ ] OpenTelemetry spans (e.g., agent.id, agent.role, agent.invocation_id, agent.principal.type, agent.delegation_depth).[ ]
- [ ] Documented W3C Baggage propagation protocol ensuring agent identity survives asynchronous and non-HTTP boundaries (job queues, event streams, tool execution sandboxes, streaming LLM completions).
- [ ] [ ] Sampling and cardinality risk assessment completed, ensuring high-frequency agent tool calls do not create prohibitive telemetry storage costs.
- [ ] [ ] Telemetry sanitization guidelines published: clear rules prohibiting sensitive material (raw tokens, private keys, message signatures, or user-identifiable payloads) from appearing in spans or logs.
- [ ] [ ] Reference trace architecture diagram showing causal lineage and identity preservation from User Request $\rightarrow$ Orchestrator Agent $\rightarrow$ Sub-Agent $\rightarrow$ Downstream Tool/Resource.
